evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes that the system capability to define geometric areas via J3.0 messages is available — a necessary precondition before C2 JU can begin defining such areas in this use case.

evidence_cards.content: Volumes are obtained by including maximum and minimum altitude values when describing multisided areas, squares, rectangles, circles, or ellipses in the J3.0 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Indicates that if volume definition is required (e.g., for 3D areas), altitude constraints must be pre-specified — implying that altitude range definitions may need to be prepared or understood prior to initiating area definition.

evidence_cards.content: The unit with R² (Reporting Responsibility) is declared inactive if a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received on an emergency point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific system state condition regarding the inactivation of reporting responsibility for emergency points, which constitutes a precondition or boundary condition for the use case context.

evidence_cards.content: Another JU may assume R² for the point by operator action only if no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a time-based condition (three consecutive missed updates) that must hold before a new unit can assume reporting responsibility, serving as a potential precondition for assuming control.

evidence_cards.content: A C2 JU or a JU capable of generating and maintaining track numbers may report an AOP based either on organic data, exchange of LOBs, analysis of EW fix data, or a combination of the above.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes that the system must have capability to generate/maintain track numbers as a prerequisite for reporting AOPs (geometric areas), which is relevant to defining geometric areas in this use case.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² for a line or area shall transmit the entire line or area upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) for any TN used to define the line or area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes that the system must already hold covariance data (R²) and have defined lines/areas associated with specific Track Numbers (TNs) before responding to update requests, which implies these are pre-existing states required for the use case context.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU with R^2 for the Reference TN shall respond with a J3.6 Space Track message upon receipt of a J7.1 message with the Data Update Request Action field set to value 2, Ballistic Missile Update Request.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes a specific system state (receipt of a J7.1 message with specific parameters) that triggers a response from the C2 JU, implying a precondition context where such requests are active and the unit holds the appropriate role (R^2).

evidence_cards.content: The system must have the capability to set filter indicators for Geographic Area (GEO), Special Processing (SP), and Simulation (SIM) status categories.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: The use case 'Define Reference Points' involves creating entities that are subject to transmission filters. The existence of these specific filter categories (GEO, SP, SIM) in the system is a prerequisite condition for defining reference points with such attributes or constraints.

evidence_cards.content: The position of a slaved point or area is established as Delta Latitude, 1/Delta Longitude, 1 from the Related TN at the time of the report when the Slaved Indicator is set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes a specific state (Slaved Indicator = 1) that must hold for the system to define a slaved point/area, serving as a precondition for that variant of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: If the J3.0E0 word is included in a report of a slaved point or area, Latitude, 0.0103 Minute and Longitude, 0.0103 Minute shall be set to No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a required data state ('No Statement' for specific fields) that must exist if the J3.0E0 word is present, acting as a precondition for valid reporting of slaved points.

evidence_cards.content: Tracks with TQ less than or equal to the restricted TQ value 'e' shall not be automatically correlated.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes a specific system state constraint regarding track quality thresholds that must hold before correlation logic (and by extension reference point definition based on tracks) can proceed.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not report a TQ value which has an associated positional accuracy which is better than that associated with own unit's current geodetic position quality.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This constraint must hold before any reporting or definition activity involving TQ values can proceed; it establishes a precondition on data validity relative to own-unit position quality.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not artificially increase TQ between sensor inputs.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a system state constraint that must be satisfied prior to processing or defining target tracks — ensures integrity of input data before use case execution.

evidence_cards.content: The C² JU uses a related TN for Impact Point only when it has R² (Responsibility) for the related missile track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes a necessary system state precondition: before defining or associating an impact point with a track, the C² JU must already hold R² for that specific missile track.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU must be capable of generating and maintaining track numbers.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This capability is a prerequisite for the system to report an AOP (Area of Probability), which is a specific type of geometric area definition within this use case.

evidence_cards.content: The use case 'Define Reference Points and Geometric Areas' is initiated by the receipt of a J7.1 message with the Data Update Request Action field set to value 2 (Ballistic Missile Update Request) or value 0 (Data Update Request by Request Indicator).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific incoming messages and field values that serve as the preconditions/triggers for the C2 JU to respond with definition data (J3.6, J3.0, etc.).

evidence_cards.content: The use case is triggered when a JU without R² desires that a specific point, line, or area be transmitted immediately without awaiting the next periodic update.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the event (desire for immediate transmission) and actor state (without R²) that initiates the action sequence involving data requests, which relates to defining or updating reference points/areas in the system context.

evidence_cards.content: The use case is triggered when the C2 JU receives a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies the specific external event (receipt of a J7.1 message) that initiates the response flow for defining/reporting data associated with a reference point or area.

evidence_cards.content: The C2 JU response to data update requests for its own TN is triggered by receiving a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message containing their own TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This explicitly identifies the triggering event for the C2 JU's response behavior related to its own track number, which is relevant to defining or updating reference points/areas associated with that TN.

evidence_cards.content: The use case is triggered when the C² JU receives a J7.1 message with the Data Update Request Action field set to value 2 (Ballistic Missile Update Request) on a specific TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This explicitly identifies the event that initiates the response sequence for defining reference points or geometric areas in the context of ballistic missile data updates.

evidence_cards.content: To define a segmented line or multisided area, the C2 JU transmits the TNs used to initiate the definition for every report of that line or area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a mandatory step in the main flow for defining these specific geometric areas.

evidence_cards.content: When defining a segmented line, the Point/Line/Area Descriptor field is set to value 2 (Line); when defining a multisided area, it is set to value 3 (Multi-point Area).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the parameter configuration required during the main flow action of defining these shapes.

evidence_cards.content: When defining a square, rectangle, circle, or ellipse, the Point/Line/Area Descriptor field is set to value 1 (Single Point Area), and the Square/Circle Switch field indicates whether the shape is square/rectangle (value 1) or circle/ellipse (value 2).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the specific data entry steps and field values required in the main flow for defining these geometric areas.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² shall initiate a force tell alert on a reference point, line, or area by setting the FT IND in the J3.0 Reference Point message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a mandatory action for the primary actor (JU with R²) to initiate an alert during the main flow of defining reference points/areas, directly contributing to the step-by-step interaction sequence.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving JUs shall accept the alert.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the system response from receiving units upon initiation of the alert, completing the first step of the canonical success scenario in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt of a J7.1 (ACT = 1) message on a specific TN, the C2 JU shall transmit J10.2 Engagement Status messages to report the status of all engagements they are conducting and a J13 Platform and System Status message to report their own status.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the mandatory response sequence for the C2 JU when receiving a data update request regarding its own track number, which is part of the interaction flow during or after defining reference points/areas that involve its own TN.

evidence_cards.content: Transmission filter interpretation for reference points is defined by combinations of GEO (Geographic Area Filter), SP (Special Processing Filter), and SIM (Simulation Filter) indicators: '0' means no filter indicator(s) are set from that category; '1' means one or more filter indicators are set. For example, when all three filters are inactive (GEO=0, SP=0, SIM=0), transmission is inhibited for any reference point or during establishment/modification of a prearranged filter.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines how the system interprets transmission filters during reference point definition — directly constraining the main flow behavior when C2 JU defines reference points under various filter conditions.

evidence_cards.content: When the J3.0 message is used to report a point, the Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field shall be set to value 0, Point, in the initial word.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a mandatory step in the main flow for reporting a reference point via J3.0 message — setting the descriptor field to indicate 'Point' type.

evidence_cards.content: When altitude is specified, Altitude, 100 Ft 1 and, if appropriate Altitude, 100 Ft 2, shall be reported in each J3.0E0 word transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies required data fields to include during altitude reporting as part of defining a reference point with elevation — a concrete action in the main flow when altitude is involved.

evidence_cards.content: If only one altitude is to be reported, the Altitude, 100 Ft 1 shall be used and Altitude, 100 Ft 2 shall be set to value 1023, No Statement.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the exact handling of optional altitude field when only single altitude is provided — a conditional step in the main flow for partial altitude specification.

evidence_cards.content: An altitude range is reported with both Altitude, 100 Ft 1 and Altitude, 100 Ft 2.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies that reporting an altitude range requires populating both altitude fields — a distinct variant path within the main flow for ranged altitudes.

evidence_cards.content: To define a segmented line or multisided area, the C2 JU transmits the TNs used to initiate the area for every report of that line or area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific transmission requirement for the actor when defining these geometric shapes.

evidence_cards.content: The Reference TN of the first J3.0 message with Line/Area Continuation Indicator set to value 0 shall be used as the only legal identifier for all subsequent references to the segmented line or multisided area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the rule for identifying and referencing the defined geometric area throughout its lifecycle.

evidence_cards.content: When describing a segmented line, the Point/Line/Area Descriptor field in the initial word shall be set to value 2; when describing a multisided area, it shall be set to value 3.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the exact data values required to distinguish between different types of geometric areas during definition.

evidence_cards.content: When defining an area that is a square, rectangle, circle, or ellipse, a specific J3.0I/J3.0E0/J3.0C2 word sequence is used, with the Point/Line/Area Descriptor set to value 1 (Single Point Area).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the initialization step and descriptor setting for defining simple geometric shapes.

evidence_cards.content: The Square/Circle Switch field indicates whether a square/rectangle (value 1) or circle/ellipse (value 2) is being described.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the parameter setting required to specify the category of the geometric shape.

evidence_cards.content: A square or circle is described when the Area Major Axis and Area Minor Axis fields are equal; a rectangle or ellipse is described when the axes are not equal.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the logic for determining the specific shape variant based on axis parameters.

evidence_cards.content: For slaved points or areas, C2 JU establishes the position as Delta Latitude and 1/Delta Longitude from a Related TN at the time of report when the Slaved Indicator is set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific interaction step for establishing the geometry of a slaved point/area relative to a reference track.

evidence_cards.content: When defining a slaved square, rectangle, circle, or ellipse, the position established by Delta Latitude and 1/Delta Longitude represents the center of that area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Clarifies the main flow action for geometric areas, specifying how the calculated offset applies to the shape's definition (center point).

evidence_cards.content: Lines and irregular multisided areas shall not be slaved.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes a constraint in the main flow regarding which geometric shapes are eligible for the 'slaved' definition method.

evidence_cards.content: To initiate a force tell alert on a reference point, line, or area, the JU with R² sets the FT IND in the J3.0 Reference Point message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the primary action for initiating an alert within the definition process.

evidence_cards.content: To terminate a force tell alert, the JU with R² transmits a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message and sets the FT IND in subsequent J3.0 messages to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific steps for terminating an alert.

evidence_cards.content: For segmented lines or multisided areas, the JU with R² initiates an alert by transmitting the FT IND set to value 1 in all J3.0 messages used to report the line or area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details the main flow action for complex geometric definitions.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving JUs shall accept the alert upon receipt of the J3.0 message with FT IND set.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system response/reception step in the interaction sequence.

evidence_cards.content: A JU initiating a force tell alert on a slaved reference point or area shall also initiate an alert on the Related TN, as specified above, if Related TN does not already have the FT IND set.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a conditional action within the main flow for handling alerts on slaved points/areas, which is part of defining and managing geometric areas.

evidence_cards.content: When the alert is terminated for the reference point or area, the JU terminating the alert shall also terminate the alert for Related TN, unless Related TN had the FT IND set prior to the slaved point or area alert being initiated.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the termination logic in the main flow for alerts associated with slaved reference points or areas.

evidence_cards.content: A JU terminating a force tell alert on a track shall also terminate the force tell alert on any reference point or area that is slaved to the track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a required step in the main flow when terminating alerts on tracks that have slaved reference points or areas.

evidence_cards.content: For a line filter (geometric area), the direction of filtering is indicated as the true compass quadrant in which a normal to the line lies; for segmented lines, this applies to the first segment described by Latitude/Longitude and Delta fields in the J7.6 message with Line/Area Continuation Indicator set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines specific input parameters and interaction steps required when C2 JU defines a segmented line geometric area, constituting part of the main flow sequence.

evidence_cards.content: A circular sector filter is defined by providing a center point, equal major and minor axes, axis orientation, beginning bearing, and ending bearing.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the sequential data entry requirements for defining a circular sector geometric area, representing a step in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: Area filters require an indication of whether the filtering is being done inside or outside the defined area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a mandatory configuration step that must be performed during the definition process for any geometric area.

evidence_cards.content: For a multisided area: The TNs used to initiate the segmented line or multisided area shall be transmitted for every report of the segmented line or multisided area, including a change of R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a mandatory step in the main flow for defining and reporting a multisided area — transmitting initiating TNs with each update, which is part of the normal interaction sequence between C2 JU and system.

evidence_cards.content: When defining an area that is a square, rectangle, circle, or ellipse, the Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field in the J3.0I word shall be set to value 1, Single Point Area. The Square/Circle Switch field indicates whether a square/rectangle (value 1) or circle/ellipse (value 2) is being described. A square or circle is described when Area Major Axis and Area Minor Axis fields are equal; otherwise, a rectangle or ellipse is described depending on the Square/Circle Switch value.

source_locations.location: section b, paragraph starting 'b. Square, Rectangle, Circles and Ellipse Definition.'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines the concrete steps and field settings required in the main flow for geometric area definition — specifically how shape type is determined via descriptor and switch values, which directly constrains the actor-system interaction during area creation.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU ceases reporting a point, line, or area for which it had reporting responsibility, it shall transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific system action required to terminate the definition of a point, line, or area, which is part of the use case flow.

evidence_cards.content: The J3.0 Reference Point message is used to report the actual or expected Impact Point of a ballistic missile.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the primary action in the main flow where C2 JU uses the J3.0 message to define/report an impact point reference.

evidence_cards.content: If the Impact point is related to a specific ballistic missile track it shall be identified in the J3.0C5 Related 2 Track Number field.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Details a specific step/field population requirement within the main flow for defining a reference point associated with a track.

evidence_cards.content: The reliability of ballistic missile launch/impact information is expressed in terms of location accuracy associated with the J3.0C5 Square/Circle Switch, Axis Orientation, Area Major Axis 4, and Area Minor Axis 4 fields.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the definition of geometric areas (squares/circles/ellipses) via specific fields, which is part of the 'Define Geometric Areas' aspect of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² shall initiate a force tell alert on a reference point, line, or area by setting the FT IND in the J3.0 Reference Point message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the primary actor's action to initiate an alert as part of defining reference points/areas — this is a step in the main flow for C2 JU when it holds R² responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving JUs shall accept the alert upon receipt of the J3.0 message with FT IND set.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines system response to the initiating action — completes the interaction sequence for alert initiation in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: The JU with R² shall terminate a force tell alert by transmitting a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message terminating the alert and setting the FT IND in subsequent J3.0 messages to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes termination procedure — part of the canonical success scenario for managing alerts during definition lifecycle.

evidence_cards.content: Optionally, alerts may be cleared by reception of a J3.0 message with FT IND set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Provides alternative completion path within main flow — still successful outcome, not an exception.

evidence_cards.content: When another JU assumes R² for the point, line, or area, it shall transmit the appropriate FT IND value as previously received in the J3.0 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes handoff behavior under normal operation — part of continuous management flow after initial definition.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² shall initiate/terminate a force tell alert by setting/clearing the FT IND in a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes alternate actor role behavior — still part of main flow when primary actor does not hold R² but initiates via J7.0.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt, the JU with R² shall set/clear the FT IND in the J3.0 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: System response to non-R² actor’s initiation — completes interaction loop in main flow variant.

evidence_cards.content: The JU with R² shall initiate a force tell alert on a segmented line or multisided area by transmitting the FT IND set to value 1 in all J3.0 messages used to report the line or area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Extends main flow to geometric areas (segmented/multisided) — specifies how alert is propagated across multiple TNs for complex shapes.

evidence_cards.content: The JU with R² shall terminate a force tell alert by transmitting a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message terminating the alert for each Reference TN which has been used to report the line or area and setting the FT IND to value 0 in subsequent J3.0 messages.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Termination procedure for complex geometries — ensures complete cleanup across all constituent TNs in main flow.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving JUs shall set the FT IND to value 1 in their database for all TNs in a segmented line or multisided area if a J3.0 message with the FT IND field set to value 1 or a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message with the Alert Status Change is received.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Final system state update upon successful alert propagation — confirms database consistency as post-action result in main flow.

evidence_cards.content: The C² JU with R² for the Reference TN shall respond with a J3.6 Space Track message upon receipt of a J7.1 message with the Data Update Request Action field set to value 2, Ballistic Missile Update Request, on a specific TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes a normal interaction sequence where C² JU responds to a data update request by transmitting held data in J3.6 word sequence — this constitutes part of the main flow for defining reference points/geometric areas via response messages.

evidence_cards.content: The JU shall transmit the data held in the appropriate J3.6 word sequence.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the action taken by the JU (transmitting held data) as part of the canonical success scenario following a valid request — directly contributes to the main_flow step of responding with defined geometric or reference point data.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU responds with a J3.0, J3.7 and/or a J6.0 Amplification message, the Response Indicator field in these messages shall be set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a required system behavior during successful response generation — setting the Response Indicator to 1 is part of the standard protocol for indicating that the message is in response to a prior request, which supports the completion of the main_flow interaction.

evidence_cards.content: For CIRCLE: Step 1 is LATITUDE/LONGITUDE – ORIGIN OF THE CIRCLE; Step 2 is AREA MAJOR AXIS, 1/AREA MINOR AXIS, 1/AXIS ORIENTATION, 1/SQUARE/CIRCLE SWITCH, 1.

evidence_cards.content: For CIRCULAR SECTOR: Step 1 is LATITUDE/LONGITUDE – ORIGIN OF THE CIRCLE; Step 2 is AREA MAJOR AXIS, 1/AREA MINOR AXIS, 1/AXIS ORIENTATION, 1/SQUARE/CIRCLE SWITCH, 1; Step 3 is BEARING 1 – START BEARING; Step 4 is BEARING 2 – END BEARING (CLOCKWISE ROTATION).

evidence_cards.content: For SECTOR OF ANNULUS: Step 1 is LATITUDE/LONGITUDE – ORIGIN OF THE CIRCLE; Step 2 defines inner arc boundary; Step 3 defines outer arc boundary; Step 4 is BEARING 1 – START BEARING; Step 5 is BEARING 2 – END BEARING (CLOCKWISE ROTATION).

evidence_cards.content: For RECTANGLE: Step 1 is LATITUDE/LONGITUDE – ORIGIN OF THE RECTANGLE; Step 2 is AREA MAJOR AXIS, 1/AREA MINOR AXIS, 1/AXIS ORIENTATION, 1/SQUARE/CIRCLE SWITCH, 1.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the main flow steps for defining a rectangular geographic area, using origin, major/minor axes, orientation, and switch to specify rectangle (vs square) shape.

evidence_cards.content: To define a segmented line, the C2 JU provides an initial point (Latitude/Longitude) in the first word sequence, followed by additional points described as Delta Latitude/Delta Longitude to form the line.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific interaction steps for defining a geometric area of type 'line'.

evidence_cards.content: To define a nested rectangle, the C2 JU provides the origin (Latitude/Longitude), followed by parameters for the major axis, minor axis, orientation, and shape switch for both the inner and outer rectangles.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the specific interaction steps for defining a geometric area of type 'nested rectangle'.

evidence_cards.content: When defining a segmented line with 2 or 3 points, the Line/Area Continuation Indicator is set to No Statement in the initial word of the word sequence.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies an alternative flow for defining short segmented lines (2-3 points) that diverges from the main flow which may assume continuation or multi-message sequences; it represents a valid successful variant path within geometric area definition.

evidence_cards.content: When defining a segmented line with 2 or 3 points, the End Point field associated with coordinates described by one of the two sets of Delta Latitude/Delta Longitude fields is set to value 1, End Point.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a required field setting specific to the alternative flow of using only 2 or 3 points — distinguishing it from longer segmented lines requiring multiple messages and continuation indicators.

evidence_cards.content: When defining a segmented line with 2 or 3 points, the Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field is set to value 2, Line, in the initial word.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This establishes the descriptor value specifically for line geometry in this alternative flow, differing from other shapes or point-based definitions covered in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: For a moving line or area defined with 2 or 3 points, a J3.0C2 word is added to the first message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an optional extension to the alternative flow (adding motion capability) while still remaining within the successful completion boundary — thus qualifying as part of the alternative flow rather than exception.

evidence_cards.content: When defining a segmented line or multisided area, any change to data concerning any point comprising a portion of the line or area shall cause the entire line or area to be transmitted by the reporting JU; receiving units shall purge the previously held version and replace it with the new report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative successful flow for updating existing segmented lines or multisided areas — diverges from initial definition main flow by requiring full retransmission on partial changes.

evidence_cards.content: The TNs used to initiate the segmented line or multisided area shall be transmitted for every report of the segmented line or multisided area, including a change of R².
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies that even during updates (alternative flow), the original initiating TNs must be included — constrains how alternative flows are structured compared to initial definition.

evidence_cards.content: The Reference TN of the first J3.0 message with Line/Area Continuation Indicator set to value 0 shall be used as the only legal identifier for all subsequent references to the segmented line or multisided area, except when dropping the line/area, setting/clearing Force Tell Indicator, or responding to a Data Update Request by TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines exceptions to the standard reference rule — these exceptions represent alternative successful paths (e.g., deletion, force tell, update request response) that diverge from normal continuation flow.

evidence_cards.content: The Point/Line/Area Descriptor field in the initial word shall be set to value 2 (Line) when describing a segmented line and to value 3 (Multi-point Area) when describing a multisided area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Provides shape-specific descriptor settings that branch from the generic geometric area definition main flow — represents alternative successful paths based on geometry type.

evidence_cards.content: When a square or rectangle (Square/Circle Switch = 1) or a circle or ellipse (Square/Circle Switch = 2) is slaved, the position established by the Delta Latitude, 1/Delta Longitude, 1 is the center of that area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow for defining geometric areas where the shape is 'slaved' to a reference track rather than being defined by absolute coordinates, diverging from the standard definition method.

evidence_cards.content: Lines and irregular multisided areas, i.e. other than squares, rectangles, circles, and ellipses, shall not be slaved.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes constraints on the alternative flow, explicitly excluding specific geometric shapes from being defined via the slaving mechanism.

evidence_cards.content: An environment/category filter allows a JU to filter tracks and nonC² IUs from the space, air, surface (maritime), subsurface (maritime), and land (ground) environment/categories, as well as reference points and electronic warfare product information.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an alternative successful path where the JU defines filters based on environment or category rather than defining geometric areas or reference points directly — diverging from the main flow of shape/geometry definition.

evidence_cards.content: An ID filter allows a JU to filter tracks and nonC² IUs based on their IDs. Identity and Identity Amplifying Descriptor are filtered in the same manner e.g., a Friend filter would filter both Friend and Exercise Friend, a Hostile filter would filter both Hostile and Faker, etc.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This represents another alternative successful path — filtering by identity attributes instead of geometry — which is a valid divergence from the main flow of defining reference points or geometric areas.

evidence_cards.content: A geographic filter allows a JU to filter tracks and nonC² IUs based on their geographic location. Maximum and minimum altitude values may also be defined for each filter that make it possible to describe volumes. Filters can be fixed geographically, slaved to the filtering JU or some other moving reference point, or move independently.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes yet another alternative successful path — defining filters by geographic volume (including altitude bounds) and mobility behavior — which diverges from the main flow’s focus on static geometric shapes like circles or squares.

evidence_cards.content: For a segmented line definition, the initial point is described by Latitude/Longitude fields contained in the first word sequence (J7.6E0), while all subsequent points are described by Delta Latitude/Delta Longitude fields (J7.6C2).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a specific alternative flow for defining geometric areas (segmented lines) that diverges from the main flow of defining reference points or simple shapes like squares/rectangles.

evidence_cards.content: When defining a multisided figure using a segmented line, the End Point field (J7.6C2) must be set to identify the associated point as the end point, which should be coincident with the last defined point to close the figure.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a condition and action required for successfully completing the alternative flow of defining a closed multisided area via a segmented line.

evidence_cards.content: When defining a segmented line with 2 or 3 points using a single J3.0 message, the Line/Area Continuation Indicator is set to No Statement in the initial word of the word sequence.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies an alternative flow variant for defining segmented lines with fewer than 4 points, diverging from the multi-message approach used for more complex geometries.

evidence_cards.content: For a segmented line formed by joining 2 or 3 points, the End Point field associated with the appropriate coordinates is set to value 1, End Point, in the continuation word.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific field setting required in this alternative path for short segmented lines, ensuring proper termination signaling within the message structure.

evidence_cards.content: In the case of a 2- or 3-point segmented line, the Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field is set to value 2, Line, in the initial word.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the descriptor value that distinguishes this alternative flow (line definition) from other geometric area definitions in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: When joining three or more points to form a segmented line, the segments are connected in sequence: the first segment is drawn from the point described in the Latitude and Longitude fields in the J3.0E0 word, to the point established by the Delta Latitude, 1 and Delta Longitude, 1 fields in the J3.0C1 word.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an alternative flow for defining a multisided area or segmented line where multiple points are joined sequentially, diverging from single-point or simple shape definitions in the main flow.

evidence_cards.content: When describing a multisided area, the last point location transmitted must be the same location as the initial point transmitted in the first word sequence, which closes the figure to form an area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a variant path for closing a multisided area by returning to the starting point, representing an alternative successful outcome distinct from open-ended segmented lines.

evidence_cards.content: To prevent confusion and possible misunderstanding, any change to data concerning any point comprising a portion of a segmented line or multisided area shall cause the entire line or area to be transmitted by the reporting JU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow for modifying existing geometric areas that diverges from the initial creation flow by requiring full re-transmission rather than incremental updates.

evidence_cards.content: The Point/Line/Area Descriptor field in the initial word shall be set to value 2, Line, when describing a segmented line and shall be set to value 3, Multi-point Area, when describing a multisided area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the branching logic (alternative path) based on the specific type of geometric area being defined (segmented line vs. multisided area).

evidence_cards.content: Corridors are reported using Point Type value 4 and Line and Point Amplification value 3.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific alternative variant for defining geometric areas (Corridor) that diverges from the standard point/area definition flow.

evidence_cards.content: Low Level Transit Routes (LLTRs) are reported using Point Type value 4 and Line and Point Amplification value 6.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific alternative variant for defining geometric areas (LLTR) that diverges from the standard point/area definition flow.

evidence_cards.content: Certain reference points and areas may be slaved in a constant position in relation to a Related TN by setting the Slaved Indicator to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow where the reference point or area is defined relative to another track rather than by absolute coordinates.

evidence_cards.content: When a square, rectangle, circle, or ellipse is slaved, the position established by Delta Latitude/Delta Longitude is the center of that area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the geometric interpretation of the slave parameters for specific shape variants.

evidence_cards.content: ASW Areas of Probability (AOP) reported in a J3.0 message with Point Type = 7 and Point Amplification = 12 shall not be slaved.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow where the general 'slaved area' definition process is explicitly bypassed for specific ASW AOP types.

evidence_cards.content: To relate or associate an ASW AOP to a track or point, e.g., a subsurface track for which contact has been lost, a J7.7 Association message may be transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the alternative action taken when defining non-slaved ASW AOPs to maintain association with other tracks.

evidence_cards.content: A JU initiating a force tell alert on a slaved reference point or area shall also initiate an alert on the Related TN, as specified above, if Related TN does not already have the FT IND set.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an alternative flow variant where alert initiation propagates to a related track number when defining alerts for slaved points/areas, diverging from standard single-point alert behavior.

evidence_cards.content: When the alert is terminated for the reference point or area, the JU terminating the alert shall also terminate the alert for Related TN, unless Related TN had the FT IND set prior to the slaved point or area alert being initiated.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies conditional divergence in termination logic for slaved reference points — terminates related TN alert only if it wasn't pre-existing, representing an alternative successful path with state-dependent branching.

evidence_cards.content: A JU terminating a force tell alert on a track shall also terminate the force tell alert on any reference point or area that is slaved to the track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes reverse propagation of termination — terminating alert on track triggers termination on all slaved reference points/areas, constituting an alternative successful flow path diverging from direct point/area termination.

evidence_cards.content: The 'LINE' definition supports a variant where the END POINT (Step 4) is set to be coincident with Point 3, which describes a multisided figure.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies a specific successful variant path for defining geometric areas (multisided figures) that diverges from or extends the basic segmented line definition by closing the shape.

evidence_cards.content: The 'NESTED RECTANGLE' definition provides an alternative flow for defining two rectangles sharing a common origin using a single word sequence (J7.6I/J7.6E0/J7.6C1).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Provides evidence of a specialized variant flow for defining complex geometric areas (nested shapes) distinct from defining single reference points or simple lines.

evidence_cards.content: If a J2 PPLI message is not received for 40 to 60 seconds, the C2 JU assumes R² of an IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific time-based exception condition (message timeout) that triggers a change in system responsibility and reporting status.

evidence_cards.content: If a J2 PPLI message is received with the NPS Indicator set to Inactive or Conditional Radio Silence, the C2 JU assumes R² of an IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a data-value based exception condition (inactive status) that triggers a change in system responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: If a J7.0 Drop Track message is received from the FJU for a PU, RU, or other IU, the C2 JU assumes R² of an IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an external command exception (drop track) that triggers a change in system responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: If the Geodetic Position Quality in the J2 PPLI message is set to value 0, the C2 JU assumes R² of an IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a quality-threshold exception (position quality = 0) that triggers a change in system responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: It is illegal to change a reference or emergency point to any other type of surveillance entity; i.e., the Reference TN used to identify a particular reference or emergency point shall not be used for any other type of entity reported on the interface except in the normal course of TN reuse.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an explicit constraint violation (illegal action) that constitutes an exception condition when attempting to redefine entity types using existing Reference TNs.

evidence_cards.content: It is illegal to change the Point Type and/or Point Amplification value of a reference point while retaining the same Reference TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies another prohibited modification scenario — changing amplification/type values without changing the Reference TN — which represents an exception path if attempted.

evidence_cards.content: As an exception to this rule a Point Amplification value of No Statement may be changed to a non-No Statement value and retain the same Reference TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Provides a specific permitted exception to the general prohibition, defining a valid recovery/override path within the otherwise illegal operation context.

evidence_cards.content: When a change is made to data concerning any point comprising a portion of a segmented line or multisided area, the entire line or area must be retransmitted by the reporting JU; receiving units shall purge the previously held version and replace it with the new report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an exception handling path for modifying existing geometric definitions — specifically, how changes trigger full replacement rather than partial updates, which constitutes an error/exception flow for maintaining consistency.

evidence_cards.content: The Reference TN of the first J3.0 message with Line/Area Continuation Indicator set to value 0 shall be used as the only legal identifier for all subsequent references to the segmented line or multisided area, except when dropping the line or area, setting/clearing the Force Tell Indicator, or responding to a Data Update Request by TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines exception conditions under which the standard identifier rule does not apply — namely during deletion, force tell operations, or update requests — representing conditional exception paths in the use case flow.

evidence_cards.content: Lines and irregular multisided areas (i.e., other than squares, rectangles, circles, and ellipses) shall not be slaved.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is a specific constraint preventing the definition of certain geometric area types under the 'slaved' condition, representing an exception flow or invalid operation path for those shapes.

evidence_cards.content: ASW Areas of Probability (AOP) reported in a J3.0 message with Point Type = 7 and Point Amplification = 12 shall not be slaved.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This is an explicit exception to the general slaving rules defined in the main and alternative flows, prohibiting slaving for specific AOP configurations.

evidence_cards.content: Emergency alerts are not used on reference points, lines, or areas.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a system constraint that acts as an exception condition: if a user attempts to initiate an emergency alert on these specific geometric types (which are part of the use case scope), the system does not support this action.

evidence_cards.content: Alerts are not used for the J3.1 Emergency Point message since these points cannot be filtered.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies another specific exception where alert functionality is disabled due to technical limitations (filtering) associated with the J3.1 Emergency Point message type.

evidence_cards.content: If an R² shift occurs during execution of a DUR response where the Number/Frequency of Updates field is set to value 2 or 3, the JU assuming R² shall not respond to any prior Data Update Request.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception condition (R² shift during DUR) that alters expected system behavior — specifically, suppressing response to prior requests — which qualifies as an exception flow for the use case involving data update handling by C2 JU.

evidence_cards.content: It is illegal to change a reference or emergency point to any other type of surveillance entity; i.e., the Reference TN used to identify a particular reference or emergency point shall not be used for any other type of entity reported on the interface except in the normal course of TN reuse.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception condition (illegal type change) that prevents successful completion of defining a reference point if attempted.

evidence_cards.content: Moreover, it is illegal to change the Point Type and/or Point Amplification value of a reference point while retaining the same Reference TN. evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines another exception condition (illegal amplification/type change with same TN) and one explicit allowed exception path, constraining valid modification behavior during reference point definition.

evidence_cards.content: Lines and irregular multisided areas (i.e., other than squares, rectangles, circles, and ellipses) shall not be slaved.

evidence_cards.content: ASW Areas of Probability (AOP) reported in a J3.0 message with Point Type = 7 and Point Amplification = 12 shall not be slaved.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific exception condition where the system prohibits slaving for certain AOP configurations, preventing the standard definition flow.

evidence_cards.content: If a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message is received, the R² unit is declared inactive.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines an exception condition that terminates the originator's reporting responsibility, which is an error or unexpected state change affecting the use case's continuity.

evidence_cards.content: If no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals, another JU may, by operator action only, assume R² for the point, line, or area using the same Reference TN(s).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies system behavior upon failure to receive expected updates — an exception path requiring manual intervention to recover reporting responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU fails to receive the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message for an emergency point and further updates are not received, the JU may purge those points after a specified time period has elapsed with no updates.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes an exception handling path where expected termination messages are missing; it defines a recovery behavior (purge after timeout) for failed update scenarios, which qualifies as exception_flow evidence.

evidence_cards.content: When a remote point, line, or area is purged from a system by local options, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies an exception condition — local purge without transmission — that deviates from normal protocol behavior, indicating an alternative or exceptional system response path relevant to exception_flow.

evidence_cards.content: The Exercise Indicator in the J3.0 message is only used to amplify messages with Point Type value 6 (Area Hazard) and Point Amplification value 3 (Allied MEZ) or 4 (Hostile MEZ); for all other values of these fields, the Exercise Indicator field shall be set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a mandatory field setting constraint that acts as an exception rule: if the user attempts to define a reference point/area with any Point Type/Amplification combination other than the specified ones while intending an 'exercise' status, the system must enforce the indicator to 0, preventing the amplification.

evidence_cards.content: A change of positional information for a point, line, or area with independent course and speed does not constitute a change of data for the purpose of setting the Periodic Report Indicator to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies an exception condition where a specific type of data update (positional change with independent course/speed) fails to trigger the standard 'data change' response (setting PER IND to 1), requiring the system to treat it differently.

evidence_cards.content: It is illegal to assume reporting responsibility for another unit's J3.7 EW Fix, AOP, or LOB report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This explicitly defines an exception flow where a user attempts to take over ownership of a reference point or area defined by another unit; the system response is that this action is prohibited ('illegal').

evidence_cards.content: When a fix is changed to an AOP, the TN of the previously reported fix shall be used for the new AOP.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies a mandatory rule (exception to the general 'new TN' requirement) for handling the transition from a specific type of reference point (Fix) to a geometric area (AOP), constraining the system behavior during this modification.

evidence_cards.content: Filters requested or reported in J7.6 messages do not apply to any messages other than the J2, J3, and J12 (on Needline PG) series messages listed above.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines scope limitation for filter application; attempting to define reference points outside these message types would be an exception condition where filters do not apply.

evidence_cards.content: J2 series PPLI data for C² IUs, J6.0 Amplification data, and J14.0 EW Parametric data are explicitly excluded from J7.6 filter application.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies specific data types that cannot be filtered via J7.6, representing exception conditions if filtering is attempted on them.

evidence_cards.content: A simulation filter applies to C² IUs as an exception to the general exclusion of non-J2/J3/J12 messages.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a unique exception case where a filter type (simulation) does apply to otherwise excluded data (C² IUs).

evidence_cards.content: The system option to retain the TN and last reported position of a fixed land (ground) IU that has reverted to an inactive status is conditional on whether 'the point is' defined or active.

evidence_cards.content: If no periodic update is received for three consecutive update intervals, another JU may assume R² for the point, line, or area using the same Reference TN(s).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a timeout-based exception condition where the original definition is superseded by another actor due to lack of updates.

evidence_cards.content: A JU shall not transmit a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message on a point when the point becomes an Active IU on the interface with the same TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a specific constraint on system behavior that acts as an exception to the general rule of transmitting termination messages for reference points.

evidence_cards.content: When a remote point, line, or area is purged from a system by local options, a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes an exception condition where the standard termination message is suppressed based on the method of purging (local options).

evidence_cards.content: For all other values of the Point Type and Point Amplification fields in the J3.0 message (other than Area Hazard/MEZ), the Exercise Indicator field shall be set to value 0.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines a mandatory constraint for reference point definition variants; failure to set this indicator to 0 for non-MEZ points constitutes an invalid configuration exception.

evidence_cards.content: A change of positional information for a point, line, or area with independent course and speed does not constitute a change of data for the purpose of setting the Periodic Report Indicator to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Clarifies the boundary condition for data change triggers, preventing false-positive exceptions where position updates might otherwise incorrectly trigger retransmission logic.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU determines that a Subsurface IU is no longer active on the interface and the JU also holds local data on the IU, it shall assume R² by reporting a J3.4 Subsurface (Maritime) Track message using the inactive IU address as the reference TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines an exception flow where the primary actor (C2 JU) assumes responsibility for an inactive unit to maintain track continuity, diverging from standard reporting procedures.

evidence_cards.content: Should the inactive IU return to the interface as an Active IU, the JU holding R² shall cease reporting the IU, but a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message shall not be transmitted.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the system response/exit behavior upon the restoration of the inactive unit, explicitly prohibiting the transmission of a Drop Track message in this specific exception scenario.

evidence_cards.content: A JU with R² shall initiate a force tell alert on a reference point, line, or area by setting the FT IND in the J3.0 Reference Point message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the valid initiation condition for alerts (R² holder), implying that non-R² holders cannot initiate via this path without alternative procedures.

evidence_cards.content: A JU without R² shall initiate/terminate a force tell alert by setting/clearing the FT IND in a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the exception flow mechanism for actors lacking R² responsibility to manage alerts.

evidence_cards.content: Upon receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message from a JU without R², the JU with R² shall set/clear the FT IND in the J3.0 message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system response and state update required when an exception flow message is received.

evidence_cards.content: Optionally, alerts may be cleared by reception of a J3.0 message with FT IND set to value 0.

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system state transformation (extrapolation) applied to non-slaved moving entities after they are defined/reported.

evidence_cards.content: After successfully defining reference points or geometric areas, the C2 JU shall not transmit air, surface, or land tracks until sufficient reporting responsibility checks, correlation, and data registration are performed; minimum wait before reporting is 12 seconds for air/surface tracks and 48 seconds for land tracks.

source_locations.location: Section 4.4.4.17 MINIMUM WAIT BEFORE TRANSMITTING TRACKS

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a mandatory system state constraint that applies after achieving Active status (which includes completing definition operations) — directly relevant to postconditions as it defines observable behavioral restrictions immediately following successful completion of track-related definitions.

evidence_cards.content: The ballistic missile covariance data shall include the best estimate of both tracking errors and statistical estimates of biases produced by emplacement errors, alignment errors, and other systematic errors.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This claim describes a specific state attribute (covariance data content) that must be present in the system's reported track data after successful definition/reporting, serving as a postcondition for the data definition process.

evidence_cards.content: Ballistic missile covariance data shall be transmitted with the root variances of the covariance matrix and elements of the Cholesky decomposition of the precompensated correlation matrix.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the required format of the data in the final system state (transmitted message), defining the observable outcome of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving JUs shall terminate the force tell alert on all TNs in a segmented line or multisided area on receipt of a J7.0 (ACT = 4) message clearing the force tell on any TN in the line or area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system-wide postcondition state after successful termination of a force tell alert via explicit clearance message — directly relevant to postconditions slot as it describes observable database/alert state change upon completion.

evidence_cards.content: When the alert is terminated for the reference point or area, the JU terminating the alert shall also terminate the alert for Related TN, unless Related TN had the FT IND set prior to the slaved point or area alert being initiated.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies conditional propagation of termination state to related entities — defines postcondition scope beyond primary entity, including exception logic based on prior state.

evidence_cards.content: A JU terminating a force tell alert on a track shall also terminate the force tell alert on any reference point or area that is slaved to the track.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes reverse dependency termination rule — defines postcondition state for slaved geometries when parent track alert is cleared.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving JUs shall accept the alert in their databases.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes mandatory database update behavior upon successful alert initiation — defines persistent system state postcondition for receiving units.

evidence_cards.content: All receiving JUs shall terminate the alert in their databases upon receipt of the J7.0 (ACT = 3 or 4) message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Explicitly states database state transition (alert termination) triggered by specific message — core postcondition for successful alert clearance use case.

evidence_cards.content: When a JU responds with a J3.0, J3.7 and/or a J6.0 Amplification message, the Response Indicator field in these messages shall be set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific system state (field value) required in response messages upon successful completion of defining reference points or geometric areas.

evidence_cards.content: If a Geographic Area Filter is set and the Reference Point Filter Indicator is set, then all points within/out the area, all lines with all points within/out the area, and all areas completely within/out the area are filtered.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the immediate observable system state (filtering behavior) after successfully defining reference points or geometric areas with active filters — directly describing postconditions of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: When the EW Filter Indicator is set, then all other Filter Indicators set in the same message apply only to EW product information data.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies how filter settings constrain the scope of applied filtering after successful definition — part of the resulting system state post-use-case completion.

evidence_cards.content: Movement of the filter shall begin at the time of transmission of the J7.6 (ACT = 1) filter description report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an immediate temporal postcondition: filter movement initiation tied to message transmission timing after successful setup.

evidence_cards.content: After successfully defining a reference point or geometric area, the C2 JU reports it as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG.

source_locations.location: Paragraph starting 'A C² JU assuming R² of an IU reports it as a track...'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes the immediate observable system state (reporting to the network) following the successful completion of the definition use case.

evidence_cards.content: The Identity shall be reported as Friend.

source_locations.location: Paragraph starting 'A C² JU assuming R² of an IU reports it as a track...'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies a mandatory attribute of the post-definition system state.

evidence_cards.content: The Track Number, Platform and Platform Activity values received in previous PPLI messages shall be reported.

source_locations.location: Paragraph starting 'A C² JU assuming R² of an IU reports it as a track...'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines how historical data is maintained and included in the post-definition state.

evidence_cards.content: The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator shall be reported as value 1, and shall be maintained if another C² JU assumes R² of the IU.

source_locations.location: Paragraph starting 'A C² JU assuming R² of an IU reports it as a track...'

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes specific field values for the defined entity in the system state and their persistence rules.

evidence_cards.content: Receiving units shall purge the previously held segmented line or multisided area and replace it with the new report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This describes a direct system state change (purge and replace) that occurs upon successful transmission of a modified geometric area definition, fulfilling the postcondition slot for observable system state after completion.

evidence_cards.content: For a slaved point or area, the position is established as Delta Latitude, 1/Delta Longitude, 1 from the Related TN at the time of the report when the Slaved Indicator is set to value 1, establishing constant true or relative bearing and range.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the resulting system state for successfully defining a slaved reference point or area.

evidence_cards.content: When a square, rectangle, circle, or ellipse is slaved, the position established by Delta Latitude, 1/Delta Longitude, 1 becomes the center of that area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the post-definition spatial relationship for slaved geometric areas.

evidence_cards.content: The slaved point or area center is plotted as the difference in Latitude and Longitude from the position of Related TN at the time of the report, regardless of whether slaved true or relative, and regardless of the course of Related TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes how the system represents the defined slaved entity after successful definition.

evidence_cards.content: When a C2 JU assumes R² of an Interface Unit (IU) and reports it as a track or point on the Surveillance Network PG, the Identity shall be reported as Friend.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a specific state attribute ('Identity') that must hold for the entity after the successful completion of the definition/assumption process described in this section.

evidence_cards.content: The PPLI Track Number and Identity Indicator fields shall be reported as value 1, and shall be maintained if another C2 JU assumes R² of the IU.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This specifies the exact values for critical identifier fields in the system state immediately following the successful assumption of responsibility.

evidence_cards.content: For a segmented line formed by joining three or more points, the segments are connected in sequence starting from the point described in the Latitude and Longitude fields of the J3.0E0 word to the point established by the Delta Latitude 1 and Delta Longitude 1 fields in the J3.0C1 word.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the final state of the geometric entity (segmented line) after the definition process is complete, specifically how the points relate spatially.

evidence_cards.content: When describing a multisided area, the last point location transmitted must be the same as the initial point location transmitted in the first word sequence, effectively closing the figure to form an area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific structural postcondition required for a multisided area to be considered 'closed' and successfully defined.

evidence_cards.content: Upon any change to data concerning a point comprising a portion of a segmented line or multisided area, receiving units shall purge the previously held segmented line or multisided area and replace it with the new report.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the immediate post-update system state for receiving units (purge and replace) ensuring data consistency after a definition change.

evidence_cards.content: The Reference TN of the first J3.0 message with Line/Area Continuation Indicator set to value 0 shall be used as the only legal identifier for all subsequent references to the segmented line or multisided area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the persistent post-definition state of the entity's identifier, restricting valid future references to the initial Reference TN.

evidence_cards.content: The Point/Line/Area Descriptor, 1 field in the initial word shall be set to value 2, Line, when describing a segmented line and shall be set to value 3, Multi-point Area, when describing a multisided area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Specifies the required field values in the initial word that characterize the defined geometric area type upon successful creation.

evidence_cards.content: For non-slaved moving points, lines, and areas, the host extrapolates them to the time of transfer to the terminal.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the system state/processing rule for non-slaved entities immediately following their definition/reporting in the context of the use case.

evidence_cards.content: Time (Hour and Minute) and Time Function may also be reported as part of the non-slaved moving point, line, or area definition.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Identifies optional data fields included in the final defined state of non-slaved moving entities.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU does not purge a point, line, or area on which it has received a J7.0 (ACT = 0) message, it shall assume R² for the entity to ensure that it remains active on the interface.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the system state (retention of responsibility/R²) for reference entities when they are not purged following a termination message, which is a specific post-definition/post-termination condition.

evidence_cards.content: Emergency points are periodically updated and are normally terminated via the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message when the emergency ceases.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Establishes the standard terminal state and mechanism for emergency points, defining the postcondition of the 'emergency ceases' event.

evidence_cards.content: If a JU fails to receive the J7.0 (ACT = 0) message and further updates are not received, the JU may purge those points after a specified time period has elapsed with no updates.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes an alternative postcondition where the system state transitions to 'purged' due to timeout rather than explicit termination.

evidence_cards.content: Upon successful definition of a reference point or geometric area, the initiating JU sets the appropriate EMG IND (Emergency Indicator) or FT IND (Force Tell Indicator) fields in the J3.2 Air Track, J3.3 Surface Track, J3.4 Subsurface Track, or J3.5 Land Point/Track message to initiate an alert.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the immediate system state (alert indicators set in track messages) resulting from the successful completion of defining a point or area by a C2 JU with R².

evidence_cards.content: All receiving JUs shall accept the alert in their databases upon receipt of the definition message.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the propagation of the post-definition state to receiving units, ensuring the defined entity and its associated alert status are stored in the network.

evidence_cards.content: For a segmented line, the end point is identified by setting the End Point field; if describing a multisided figure, this point should be coincident with the last intermediate point (Point 3).
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the specific state condition required to successfully complete the definition of a closed geometric area (multisided figure) via a segmented line.

evidence_cards.content: For a nested rectangle, the system state includes an origin defined by Latitude/Longitude and two distinct sets of axis parameters (Major Axis, Minor Axis, Orientation) for the inner and outer rectangles.

source_locations.location: Table 4.7-6, Row 'NESTED RECTANGLE', Description Items 1, 2, and 3

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Describes the complete data structure and geometric parameters that constitute the defined entity upon successful completion of the use case for this specific shape variant.

evidence_cards.content: For a multisided area defined as slaved (Slaved Indicator = 1), the center position is established using Delta Latitude, 1 and Delta Longitude, 1 fields relative to the Related TN.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: This defines a specific postcondition state for slaved geometric areas — namely, how their spatial reference is resolved after successful definition. It directly contributes to the 'system state after use case completes' by specifying coordinate derivation logic tied to slaving.

evidence_cards.content: For a slaved point or area, the position is established as Delta Latitude, 1/Delta Longitude, 1 from the Related TN at the time of the report when the Slaved Indicator is set to value 1.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the postcondition state for successfully defining a slaved reference point or geometric area — specifically how its position is anchored relative to a Related TN after successful definition.

evidence_cards.content: When a square, rectangle, circle, or ellipse is slaved, the position established by the Delta Latitude, 1/Delta Longitude, 1 fields is the center of that area.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Clarifies the postcondition for slaved geometric areas: their center (not corner or edge) is positioned via delta offsets from the Related TN, which constrains how the system represents and renders them after successful definition.

evidence_cards.content: A circle filter is defined by a center point, a major and minor axis that are equal, and an axis orientation.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Provides specific postcondition details for the state of a defined circular geographic area (equal axes).

evidence_cards.content: Filters can be fixed geographically, slaved to the filtering JU or some other moving reference point, or move independently.
evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Defines the possible movement states (fixed vs. slaved) of the system after a geographic filter is successfully defined.

evidence_cards.content: For a nested rectangle, the system state includes an origin defined by Latitude/Longitude and two distinct sets of axis parameters (Major Axis, Minor Axis, Orientation) for the inner and outer rectangles.

source_locations.location: Table 4.7-6, row 'NESTED RECTANGLE', Description column items 1, 2, and 3

evidence_cards.slot_relevance: Directly defines the postcondition state structure for nested rectangles, resolving the consistency issue regarding field-level population of inner/outer axis sets in the main flow.
